prompt: A toy flash controller starts LOCKED. It unlocks only after it sees KEY1 and then KEY2 back to back. Any other write to the key register relocks it.

explain: The sequence must be uninterrupted: a wrong write resets to LOCKED, so the unlock has to start over. This guards against stray writes accidentally enabling program or erase.
